cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena, often described as the source of all existence and change.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a transcendental, unnameable reality that cannot be fully captured by language.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken between two points.
cards.Nuance (English): Often used in the context of travel or journey.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The path is distant and cannot be traversed lightly.|This road leads to the summit.|Travelers walk along the path.|The ancient road still exists today.
cards.Sentences: 道遠，不可輕行。|此道通向山頂。|行人沿道而行。|古道今猶在。
